CA.rationale: Identified content (red for p0/current/n3) is explicitly linked to a processing/origin condition (feedback_through) at the same referent/time.

COD.rationale: Content (red set) and its presentation/organization (origin) are separately expressed for the same referent/time, satisfying C+O+D binding.

A.rationale: A processing condition ('feedback_through' / history_estimate) is explicitly attached to the same content referent, linking process/attention-like condition to content presentation/access.

C.rationale: Multiple explicit content identifiers (red/blue coordinate sets) name represented contents and attributes.

D.rationale: The report separately records content identity (red set) and its status/origin (history_estimate/feedback_through), distinguishing identification from organization/status.

O.rationale: Explicit origin/inheritance fields describe how represented contents are organized and where they derive from, as organization/presentation metadata.
